title: Jehoiachin
lead: King of Judah for three months in 598/597 BC, taken to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar and kept there for 37 years until Evil-merodach released him (2 Kings 24:8-16; 25:27-30; Jeremiah 52:31-34). Babylonian ration tablets name him 'Ya'ukin, king of Yahudu'. Jeremiah condemned him (Jeremiah 22:24-30), and Matthew places 'Jeconiah' at the hinge of the genealogy of Jesus (Matthew 1:11-12).
